items.prompt: Look at the picture. Write three sentences about what you can see.

figure.alt: A park, a child running and a ball.

hints: Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.
items.explanation: Check your sentences. Each one starts with a capital letter, ends with a full stop and makes sense.

criteria.label: Writes about the picture or the topic

items.model: I can see a park. A boy is running. He has a big ball.

items.prompt: Write a short diary entry about yesterday. Write four sentences.
hints: What did you do in the morning?
Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.
items.explanation: Check your sentences. Each one starts with a capital letter, ends with a full stop and makes sense.

criteria.label: Writes about the picture or the topic

planning: What did you do in the morning?
What did you do after school?
items.model: Yesterday I woke up early. I had rice for breakfast. After school I played football. In the evening I read a book.

items.prompt: Look at the picture. Write four sentences. Say where the things are.

figure.alt: A bed, a book and a clock.

hints: Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.
items.explanation: Check your sentences. Each one starts with a capital letter, ends with a full stop and makes sense.

criteria.label: Writes about the picture or the topic

planning: Use in, on and next to.
items.model: The bed is in my room. The book is on the bed. The clock is next to the bed. It is seven o'clock.

items.prompt: Write about your best friend. Write four sentences.
hints: What does your friend look like?
Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.
items.explanation: Check your sentences. Each one starts with a capital letter, ends with a full stop and makes sense.

criteria.label: Writes about the picture or the topic

planning: What does your friend look like?
items.model: My best friend is Dina. She has long hair. We play together at school. She is kind and funny.

items.prompt: Write a short story. A boy finds a key in the garden. What does it open? Write five sentences.

figure.alt: A key, a tree and a box.

hints: Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.
items.explanation: Check your sentences. Each one starts with a capital letter, ends with a full stop and makes sense.

criteria.label: Writes about the picture or the topic

items.model: Rafi found a small key under a tree. He ran inside to look for a lock. The key opened an old box. Inside the box there was a map. Rafi smiled and went to find the treasure.

items.prompt: Look at the pictures. Write three sentences about them.

figure.alt: A dog, a ball and a park.

hints: Say what each one is doing.

criteria.label: Writes three sentences about the pictures

items.model: A dog is in the park. It is playing with a ball. The dog looks happy.

items.prompt: Write a letter to a friend. Invite them to your house for lunch.
hints: Say the day and the time.
End with Best wishes and your name.
items.explanation: A letter has a start and an end.

criteria.label: Starts with Dear and ends with a goodbye

items.model: Dear Ayu, Would you like to come to my house for lunch on Sunday? We will eat noodles and fruit. Please come at twelve. Best wishes, Lina

items.prompt: Write a diary entry about a day when something surprising happened.
hints: Start with the day and the date.
Say what happened first, next and last.
items.explanation: A diary tells what happened and how you felt.

criteria.label: Uses past tense and correct punctuation
